title: PageFilterDescriptor
description: Describes a runtime filter control for an entity page.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: each filter must point to a page entity property. Use `control: "auto"` unless a specific control is needed. Use text/contains for string search, range/between for numeric values, dateRange/timeRange for temporal values, select/multiSelect for enums, lookup for foreign keys, and exists for null checks. Do not use the legacy `operator` property; use `defaultOperator`.

propertyName.description: Property filtered by this control. Must match a property on the page entityName.

label.description: Optional page-specific label override. Omit to use the property displayName/name.

order.description: Filter display order. Lower values appear first.

visible.description: Whether the filter is shown at runtime

control.description: Runtime control used by the filter. 'auto' selects based on property type; choose explicit controls for predictable generated UI.

defaultOperator.description: Default operator applied by this filter. Use 'contains' for text search, 'equal' for enum/FK exact matches, 'between' for ranges, and 'default' to let runtime choose.

allowedOperators.description: Operators the runtime filter UI allows users to choose. Omit to let the runtime choose based on property type/control.

defaultValue.description: Optional default filter value applied when the page first loads. Shape depends on control/operator.

allowMultipleValues.description: Whether the filter can submit multiple values. Useful with multiSelect/in/notIn.

clearable.description: Whether runtime users can clear the filter.

initiallyExpanded.description: Whether the runtime filter panel opens expanded.
